alex: FYI — PM asked for a concrete proposal on SLO-driven routing by customer tier + regional fallbacks + model-variant circuit breakers. Need API shape, console UX, and telemetry plan. Who wants to own the API shape?

maya: I can sketch a policy DSL. We should support per-tier latency_ms and availability_pct targets, with optional CB thresholds based on error-rate and p95 latency. Minimal example: YAML ->

maya: ```
policy:
  tiers:
    - name: standard
      latency_ms: 300
      availability_pct: 99.9
      cb:
        error_rate_pct: 5
        consecutive_failures: 10
    - name: enterprise
      latency_ms: 150
      availability_pct: 99.99
      cb:
        error_rate_pct: 2
        consecutive_failures: 5
  fallback_order: [same-region-variant, cross-region-variant, cheaper-quantized]
```

tariq: Love it. A few concerns: 1) how do we represent region affinity vs forced cross-region fallback? 2) telemetry needs to disambiguate model-variant fallback calls so we can track quality regressions per variant.

irene: For (1) add fields like `allow_cross_region: true|false` and `max_cross_region_latency_ms`. For (2) we need route tags emitted with each request (tier, chosen_variant, fallback_reason) and spans for latency breakdown. That will feed the console dashboards.

alex: Good. On API shape — prefer a single route policy object attached to customer config with an ordered list of candidate model variants, each with constraints. Example JSON snippet:

alex: ```json
{
  "policy_id": "p-123",
  "tier": "enterprise",
  "candidates": [
    {"model": "redwood-v2", "region": "us-west-2", "max_latency_ms": 160},
    {"model": "redwood-v2-quant", "region": "us-west-2", "max_latency_ms": 80},
    {"model": "redwood-v1", "region": "us-east-1", "max_latency_ms": 200, "allow_cross_region": true}
  ],
  "circuit_breaker": {"error_rate_pct": 2, "rolling_window_s": 60}
}
```

maya: UX: console should surface an interactive policy editor plus a simulated traffic slider that shows expected SLO breaches and estimated token-cost delta when fallbacks trigger. Also a timeline of historical fallbacks and the most common fallback_reason values.

tariq: Telemetry specifics — emit metrics per route: requests_total, fallbacks_total, fallback_by_reason (labels), p50/p95/p99 latency per variant, error_rate, token_cost. We should tag by customer_id and tier for aggregation.

dev-bot: deploy pipeline: policy-api v3 -> staging -> canary on 10% traffic. Deploy job queued by @ci.

irene: Ops playbook: when CB trips for enterprise tier in a region, auto-roll to next candidate and alert on-call + create a regression eval run for sample prompts. We should also have automatic rollback for canary if fallback rate > X.

alex: Action items: (1) maya to draft full DSL + example policies (2) tariq + irene to list telemetry + dashboard widgets (3) i'll own API proto + canary behavior defaults. Aim for proposal doc by EOD Friday.

console-team: noted — we'll prototype the simulated slider component once maya lands DSL.

maya: will start a small PR with DSL README and a couple of sample customer policies.

alex: thanks all. short sync tomorrow 11am to align on edges (quota interaction, multi-tenant CB scopes). :thumbsup:
